title: Elon Musk says US government contracts will account for under 10% of SpaceX's revenue this quarter, down from 16.6% last quarter and around 20% in 2025 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Elon Musk says US government contracts will account for under 10% of SpaceX's revenue this quarter, down from 16.6% last quarter and around 20% in 2025 — SpaceX's reliance on US government-funded contracts will continue to shrink, Elon Musk said, signaling a shift in focus away …
